mapping.cbc-free: A  Java-based constraint programming toolkit supporting finite domain constraints and offering customizable search strategies for discrete optimization.
mapping.choco-solver__cp_-free: A Solver mode that integrates CP with SAT-style reasoning to handle complex and hybrid combinatorial models more efficiently in a free configuration.
mapping.choco-solver__cp-sat_-free: A powerful constraint programming solver tailored for scheduling, planning, and sequencing, providing strong propagation and heuristic search.
mapping.cp_optimizer-free: A solver supporting LP, MILP, and QP, known for fast branch-and-bound, presolve, and cutting-plane methods; commonly used in academia.
mapping.cplex-free: A leading commercial solver for LP, MILP, QP, and more, recognized for state-of-the-art performance, parallelization, and tuning tools.
mapping.gurobi-free: An open-source suite for LP, MILP, and QP that includes simplex and interior-point methods; designed to be lightweight, modern, and easy to integrate into scientific workflows.
mapping.highs-free: A free solver from the MiniZinc ecosystem that blends constraint and logic programming; supports expressive modeling and integrates cleanly with MiniZinc workflows.
mapping.izplus-free: This is an open-source Java CP solver providing advanced propagators and search heuristics, especially popular in education and prototyping of discrete decision models.
mapping.jacop-free: A free SAT and Max-SAT solver aimed at optimization-centric Boolean reasoning, providing clause learning and heuristics suitable for decision and cost-based models.
mapping.pumpkin-free: A free solver that unifies mixed-integer programming and constraint programming with nonlinear extensions; known for strong presolve, cutting planes, and flexibility.
mapping.scip-free: A free solver that blends Prolog with constraint logic programming capabilities, enabling expressive models for combinatorial reasoning and inference.
mapping.sicstus_prolog-free: An open-source MILP solver specializing in integer and linear optimization, widely used as a robust and lightweight alternative to commercial engines.
